patterns.description: La descripción oficial de la fee de Gumroad contradice en los documentos del corpus: SC-R1-005 declara '10% + $0.50 por transacción' mientras SC-R1-032 y SC-R1-035 declaran '10% flat fee' sin el componente de $0.50. Las tres cards son del mismo actor (platform) y referencian la misma plataforma y tipo de venta.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-005: Gumroad pricing page: 10% + $0.50 per transaction for all sales through seller profiles or direct links
signal_summaries.SC-R1-032: Gumroad help center (July 2023): $0 to start, 10% flat fee per sale, excluding credit card processing and PayPal fees
signal_summaries.SC-R1-035: Gumroad help center: 10% flat fee for sales made on Gumroad's website, excluding credit card processing and PayPal fees (snippet truncated)

patterns.routing_rationale: All three signal IDs have actor=platform. Same-actor filter: all signals across both poles share actor=platform → same_actor_discrepancy. Route to rejected_grouping. Note: this may reflect versioning (SC-R1-032 dated July 2023, SC-R1-035 undated, SC-R1-005 undated) rather than a current contradiction.

components.label: Polo B — fee declarada como 10% flat
components.summary: Help center articles state 10% flat fee (excluding CC and PayPal fees)

patterns.description: La condición de elegibilidad para Discover contradice entre fuentes del corpus: SC-R1-055 (actor=seller) declara que Gumroad no promoverá un producto hasta que el seller gane sus primeros $10; SC-R1-062 (actor=seller) reporta que Discover no muestra productos antes de la primera venta; SC-R1-073 (actor=platform) declara criterios de elegibilidad no especificados sin mencionar umbral monetario.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-055: Seller states Gumroad will not promote via Discover until seller earns first $10
signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller with 26 products: zero Discover views; attributes to threshold before first sale
signal_summaries.SC-R1-073: Gumroad help center: products listed on Discover once unspecified eligibility criteria are satisfied

patterns.routing_rationale: SC-R1-073 has actor=platform; SC-R1-055 and SC-R1-062 have actor=seller. Different actor values → passes same-actor filter. The opposition is partial: platform card does not explicitly contradict the $10 threshold, it simply does not specify it. The seller-side cards report a threshold the platform card does not confirm. This is not a clean explicit contradiction — it is a gap in specificity that creates apparent inconsistency. Route to needs_audit for the candidate builder to evaluate.

components.label: Polo A — umbral de elegibilidad especificado por sellers
components.summary: Sellers report $10 or first-sale threshold for Discover activation

components.label: Polo B — criterios de elegibilidad no especificados en documentación oficial
components.summary: Platform help center states eligibility required but does not specify threshold
